safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not explicitly document that the patient has no prior history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document the patient’s denial of prior anaphylaxis removes an important risk-stratifier for a potentially life-threatening presentation (post-sting dyspnea/lip symptoms). This may lead subsequent clinicians to treat the history as unknown and potentially over-triage, over-monitor, or repeat questioning/testing.
